Mcs/VoiceEnabled Description: Enable Assistant voice command recognition (STT + LLM). Required to use voice control over AI escorts.
Mcs/VoiceTriggerMode Description: Trigger mode: PushToTalk holds a key to talk; FreeTalk auto-records via VAD without key.
Mcs/VoiceHotKey Description: Hotkey for PushToTalk mode. Ignored under FreeTalk.
Mcs/VoiceCaptureMaxSeconds Description: Maximum single recording length in seconds. Long phrases are cut at this limit.
Mcs/VoiceVadEnergyThreshold Description: RMS energy threshold that triggers speech start in FreeTalk. Lower if whispers are ignored.
Mcs/VoiceVadSilenceSeconds Description: Silence duration to end the recording in FreeTalk.
Mcs/VoiceFeedbackSubtitles Description: Show in-game notification after each voice command is dispatched.
Mcs/SttProvider Description: Cloud Speech-to-Text provider. None disables voice control; OpenAI Whisper is recommended for international users.
Mcs/SttApiKey Description: API key for the chosen STT provider.
Mcs/SttBaseUrl Description: Optional custom STT base URL (overrides per-provider default).
Mcs/SttModel Description: Optional STT model name (provider-specific). Leave blank for default.
Mcs/SttLanguage Description: Hint language code in BCP-47 (e.g. zh-CN, en-US, ja-JP) for STT.
Mcs/LlmProvider Description: Cloud LLM provider. None disables LLM interpretation; OpenAI-Compatible covers OpenAI / DeepSeek / Moonshot / Ollama / vLLM etc.
Mcs/LlmApiKey Description: API key for the chosen LLM provider.
Mcs/LlmBaseUrl Description: Optional custom LLM base URL (overrides per-provider default for OpenAI-Compatible).
Mcs/LlmModel Description: LLM model name. Provider-specific; default gpt-4o-mini for OpenAI-Compatible.
Mcs/LlmSystemPrompt Description: Optional custom system prompt prepended to Assistant's voice-command instruction template.
Mcs/LlmTemperature Description: LLM sampling temperature, 0..2. Lower is more deterministic.
Mcs/LlmMaxTokens Description: Maximum tokens LLM may emit. Affects cost/latency.
Mcs/VoiceProviderMissing: A STT/LLM provider is not configured.
